selection.method: Purposeful coverage of recorded public outcome strata with six IDs per split; no random or blind-test claim

questions.rationale: A long-chain hydrocarbon viscosity question replaces the already successful current DEV electron-acceptor case within the historical MCQ refusal stratum.
Physical-science light-production question broadens the refusal stratum beyond the prior chemistry example.
A height-relative-to-sea-level question replaces the chemical-reaction terminology case within the historical MCQ refusal stratum to retain six IDs per original split.
A short mechanics question permits inspection of whether a compact public definition exists and reaches the supplied evidence.
A telophase question replaces the already successful current DEV organ-system case within the historical completed OpenQA EM-regression stratum; E1 token F1 was 0.5.
Water-vapor terminology has zero historical E1 token overlap. This warrants separate corpus-coverage, evidence-sufficiency and answer review without presuming which caused the mismatch.
Genetics definition case with historical E1 F1 0.4 permits inspection of partial lexical overlap versus completeness of the submitted evidence.
A percentage and missing-term question with historical E1 F1 2/3 permits numeric, qualifier and extraction review under the unchanged scorer.
Plant-function case lost both MCQ selection and OpenQA EM through refusal; it links the two protocol partitions without asserting retrieval failure.
Protein terminology case lost both MCQ selection and OpenQA EM through refusal; it adds a distinct source-definition requirement.
One of the two retained pre-provider execution failures: E1 EM was already zero, while F1 fell from 0.2 to zero. Treat as infrastructure evidence, not a semantic RAG error.
The second retained pre-provider execution failure: E1 EM was already zero, while F1 fell from 2/7 to zero. Preserve it separately from answer/refusal regressions.

prospective_design.matched_policy: Use the identical OpenQA system policy, output schema, model configuration, output cap, confidence/refusal rule and extraction across all three arms. Permit the same model-knowledge fallback. Only supplied evidence may differ. Question stems are unchanged, choices are absent, and history/profile are empty.
prospective_design.alias_score: Optional separately versioned whole-compact-answer diagnostic after generation closure; retain primary EM/F1 unchanged

failure_attribution.corpus_coverage: An empty or irrelevant candidate union does not establish absence from the full released corpus; require separate source search/review evidence.
failure_attribution.automatic_source_labels: Label only stem plus exact public passages/provenance, with no expected labels, historical scores, generated answers or ranks. Store broad relevance and complete answer sufficiency separately; preserve unknown/disputed labels and source quotes.
failure_attribution.synonym_scoring: A completed EM regression or partial token overlap is a lexical observation. Synonym equivalence needs an independent declared diagnostic; do not relabel it factual error from scores alone.
failure_attribution.rerank_harm: Compare R2 input pool and reranked output on unchanged candidate memberships and texts. Harm is observed only when judged relevant or sufficient evidence is demoted or lost; historical R0-only E1 outcomes do not show rerank harm.

retrieval_metric_contract.candidate_universe: Per-question frozen unique union of twenty R0 dense candidates and twenty R2 hybrid candidates, using exact chunk/text identities; publish actual counts and complete memberships. This preparation has not retrieved the twelve pools.
retrieval_metric_contract.fixed_P_at_5: Confirmed relevant returned positions / 5; report unknown bounds. Strict point precision is unavailable if any top-five label is unknown.
retrieval_metric_contract.precision_among_actual_returned: Confirmed relevant returned / actual returned count, with its own explicit denominator; NULL when no passage is returned or any returned-passage relevance judgment is unknown.
retrieval_metric_contract.pool_relative_recall: Relevant returned / all relevant members of the fully judged frozen union; NULL if any pool label is unresolved or the union has no positives.
retrieval_metric_contract.sufficient_evidence_rate: Separate confirmed fully sufficient returned positions / 5 using the sufficiency rubric; do not substitute broad relevance P@5.

supersedes_preparation01.reason: OpenQA-only budget scope and exclude already successful current three-question DEV cases

historical_infrastructure_attribution_so.statement: The original public report attributes the two E1 execution errors to OutOfMemoryError and MemoryError before provider execution. The numeric outcome audit itself records only EXECUTION_FAILED.
